question_text:
Two long, straight and parallel wires are placed in free space. Consider the following two cases as shown in the figures.
(a) Wires carry the same current \textit{I} in the same direction.
(b) Wires carry the same current \textit{I} in opposite directions. Consider the x-axis to be along the line joining the wires, with the origin at the midpoint. Which pair of graphs best represents the variation of the magnetic flux density \textit{B} between the two wires?
